title: The opening: you are lucky to be here
subtitle: The first pages of the second edition as Dinis described them, in 16 panels: wonder, not fear; the history; technology that finally works for you; learning made for you; and why that makes you a developer.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from Dinis's memo on the core idea
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is Dinis's words from the article 'You are lucky to be here', word for word; the build checks it. The other characters' lines are the storyboard's.
